name: Lake Zarovich, the wolf hills and Lake Baratok

places.name: Lake Zarovich
places.summary: The great black lake north-west of Vallaki. On its south-west shore, the fishers' landing: empty huts, a rotten jetty, and Bluto's rowboat.

places.name: The Werewolf Den
places.when: flag.werewolf_rumor or flag.den_way_known or tarokka.tome.region == werewolf_den or tarokka.symbol.region == werewolf_den or tarokka.sword.region == werewolf_den or tarokka.ally.npc == emil_toranescu
places.summary: A cave under a rock face in the hills above Lake Zarovich's north shore, where a pack of werewolves sleeps by day and worships Mother Night.

places.name: Van Richten's Tower
places.when: flag.tower_rumor or flag.khazan_known or tarokka.tome.region == van_richtens_tower or tarokka.symbol.region == van_richtens_tower or tarokka.sword.region == van_richtens_tower
places.summary: A dead archmage's black tower on an island in Lake Baratok, a cold tarn under Mount Baratok. Rudolph van Richten keeps it now; a Vistani wagon is parked on the shore.

places.name: The Hill Trail
places.summary: A trappers' trail through the pines on the hills above Lake Zarovich, where the hunters set their snares.
